owner_statement.text: Owner, 25 Nov 2026: "If the covers are not present, design them consistently like the already present covers."

basis: Designed by Claude at the owner instruction above, matching the existing Earnalism cover series (painted scene, gold Bengali title, author line, footer; textured back with a gold line-art motif, tagline, summary and year). Front and back illustrations generated with Krea 3 on the owner ElevenLabs Creator plan (flow uP0ao4gyge6DhUsgXiKo; commercial use under that plan terms); lettering set in Noto Serif Bengali, Noto Sans Bengali and Source Serif 4 (SIL OFL). Uploaded to the owner Cloudinary; front and back share the asset UUID. Requires the owner cover approval on the Monday page.
scope: Cover display only; grants no text, audio or publication authorization.
